titleinfo.title: 240p Dream
titleinfo.description: The ultimate native 240p emulator for Xbox 360 (by tupapa2712), optimized for analog CRT TVs. Enjoy 8-bit and 16-bit classics with real scanlines, Nearest-Neighbor sharpness, zero vertical bounce, and automatic return to menu (LB+RB+Select). Open-source fork and modification of Salvia 360.
